validation_mode: independent re-analysis from primary open-access sources; 5 parallel worker streams

external.paper: Smith/Bradley/Morrill Gavarro et al., Nature Communications 2023

claims.claim: post-treatment DDR score inversely correlates with PFI (Spearman rho=-0.711, p=0.014)
claims.note: Re-derived from raw GEO UMI matrix (51786 cells, 32/32 pathway genes present, SHA d604a459df7e5e70) using the manuscript's own gene sets and documented pseudobulk pipeline. Correlation is weak and non-significant under both label splits (rho vs continuous PFI is label-independent).
claims.action: Correct/retract the -0.711 value in ABSTRACT.md, MANUSCRIPT_DRAFT.md, BriTROC1_VALIDATION_RESULTS.md; re-derive with a fully specified deposited pipeline before any restatement.

claims.claim: post-treatment PI3K score: rho=-0.683 p=0.020, AUC=0.750
claims.note: Reproduced correlation has the OPPOSITE sign (+0.109) and AUC is 0.36-0.50, not 0.75.
claims.action: Correct/retract; PI3K result is not the highest-AUC feature and is not significant on re-analysis.

claims.claim: Kaplan-Meier high vs low post-DDR log-rank p=0.0124
claims.note: Median-split KM on the same n=11 gives log-rank p=0.072, not 0.0124. (Also affected by disclosed median-split leakage.)

claims.claim: pathway deltas (post - pre) do not predict PFI (|rho|<0.3, p>0.3)
claims.note: The delta-null result reproduces cleanly and is the artifact's one reproduced discovery claim.
Only reaches ~0.75 under the manuscript's own (superseded) 8R/3S labels; 0.571 under corrected labels. AUC is label-dependent.

claims.claim: CN signature 7 at relapse AUROC=0.874 (95% CI 0.750-0.974), Wilcoxon p=0.035
claims.note: Independently reproduced to 3 decimals from open-access Nature Comms supplementary.
claims.action: Retain; pair with n=3 fragility caveat (C09).

claims.note: Exact. s6 improvement +0.2613 also supported; s4 improvement 0.000 as claimed.

claims.claim: discovery resistance split = 8 resistant / 3 sensitive (EOC227 resistant)
claims.note: Repo's own corrected resistance_labels.json (2026-05-09, from source Table 1) gives 7R/4S; EOC227 PFI=230d >= 180d is sensitive. Package inconsistent with its own source of truth.
claims.action: Adopt 7R/4S as canonical; show 8R/3S side-by-side with provenance note.

claims.claim: BriTROC resistant count (some tables state 10 resistant); 'excellent discrimination'
claims.note: Correct count is 3 resistant / 37 sensitive. LORO shows a stable central AUROC (0.865-0.892) but the CI is wide (0.76-0.97) on only 3 events.
claims.action: Fix '10' -> '3'; reframe as stable point estimate with wide uncertainty, not 'excellent'.

claims.claim: serial monitoring can detect resistance 3-6 months before progression
claims.note: Repo audit + OV-045 red-team: resistance signal present continuously (TF 1.0% day56, 0.8% day362). Package proves prognostic, not temporal-predictive.
claims.action: Downgrade to dynamic risk stratification; remove temporal early-detection claim.

claims.claim: Introduction: 'pathway changes during treatment predict resistance'
claims.note: Contradicts the delta-null result (C04). Core thesis is absolute post-treatment state, not change.
claims.action: Rewrite Introduction sentence to match the finding.

claims.note: BH-FDR on the 7 as-published tests: 6/7 survive FDR<0.05. But note the underlying p-values do not reproduce (C01-C03), so FDR is moot for discovery until re-derivation.
claims.action: Add FDR statement; supersede once discovery numbers are re-derived.

claims.claim: EPV is low (~2-4); no cross-validation; median-split leakage
claims.note: Confirmed and quantified: discovery EPV 1.0-1.33; single-feature 4.0; BriTROC 3.0. All << 10.

claims.claim: Zhang et al. GSE165897 cited as PMID 36223460
claims.note: Correct identifier: Zhang K et al., Science Advances 2022, DOI 10.1126/sciadv.abm1831 (PMC8865800). The label file's DOI is authoritative; the manuscript PMID is mismatched.

claims.claim: s7-at-relapse improvement supports resistance-associated post-treatment state
claims.note: BriTROC-1 paper's own headline is genome stability diagnosis->relapse with no selection for common CN drivers. Not strictly contradictory (s7 is exposure, more discriminative not more driven), but the +0.18 shift rests on 3 resistant patients.
claims.action: Add interpretive caveat in BriTROC annotation.

claims.note: Repo audit states data possessed locally; text stale. MSK-Spectrum is controlled-access and NOT used in this validation.
claims.action: Update status text; note it is not part of published results.

claims.claim: biological direction (post-DDR-high, CN s7/CCNE1, PI3K) coherent with resistance
claims.note: Direction plausible: platinum selects repair-proficient cells; s7~CCNE1 amplification is a recognized platinum-resistance/HR-proficiency mechanism. Not a substitute for power/validation.

overall_assessment: External BriTROC-1 copy-number finding reproduces essentially exactly and is the strongest element. Discovery-cohort headline statistics (DDR/PI3K correlations, KM) do NOT reproduce from raw GEO data under the documented methodology; only the delta-null result reproduces. Multiple label/count discrepancies and prognostic-vs-predictive overstatements corrected. Artifact remains Tier 3 hypothesis-generating, RUO; not clinical evidence.
